case_selection: First N official MultiCounterFact records; nested sets shared by all seeds and variants
optimizer: Adam default betas/eps, no weight decay
precision: FP32; deterministic algorithms; eager full attention; TF32 disabled
targets: Official rewrite target_new tokens followed by EOS only; prompt loss masked
batch_rule: Exact token lengths, no padding, duplicate fill to B8; filler targets masked and excluded from exposure counts
initialization: Immutable local vendor backbone; module-name and seed keyed branch initialization; other projections shared across capacity variants
checkpoint_rule: Final fixed epoch only; no test-based parameter or checkpoint selection
evaluation: Every official rewrite, paraphrase and neighborhood of every edited case; new and true candidates retained; no generation-side metrics in this protocol
calibration: Official case index modulo 10 equals zero; all other cases are test. Both folds' rewrite updates are trained, as in batch knowledge editing; paraphrases and neighborhoods never train
retrieval_baseline: Unedited base model with inverted-index BM25 over training rewrite/new facts only; top-1 and top-3 chosen using calibration harmonic score only
interpretation: Counterfactual knowledge updating, not verification of contemporary facts. Benchmarks do not establish superiority to MEMIT/ROME editing algorithms. Full-table wins must retain locality and beat independently trained cheaper controls; native storage claims require separate source-qualified fidelity/serving runs
